subject: Compact Renewal QBR — proposed condensed demo windows & procurement handoff
message_1_subject: Re: Compact Renewal QBR — timeline constraints
message_1_body:
Markus —

Thanks for the heads up on the QBR cadence. We want to keep this session tight (90 minutes max) and combine the roadmap walkthrough with the renewal discussion so our execs can justify headcount and procurement ramp.

Two constraints from our side: 1) procurement freezes any contract language until Dec 5 (they need a 72-hour review window), and 2) we have a leadership offsite Nov 28–29 so earlier the better. Can we lock a session the week of Nov 27 that is under 90 minutes?

Looping in Carl Ng from procurement for timing/contract checks — Carl, appreciate any redline timing notes.

Best,
Anna
Anna Priestley
Head of Product Ops | Catalina Health
anna.priestley@catalinahealth.com
(415) 555-0182
message_2_body:
Anna —

Thanks — appreciate the constraints. Draft plan attached: a 90-minute compact run-of-show that combines a 30-minute exec highlight, 35-minute roadmap demo (targeted to your top two use cases), and a 25-minute procurement/next-steps block.

Possible windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 28 — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed Nov 29 — 08:30–10:00

If those conflict with your offsite, we can also do Mon Nov 27 16:00–17:30. We can compress the demo by pre-recording a 10-minute snippet for the execs and using the live time for Q&A.

Attachments: 2028-11-20_Catalina_QBR_agenda_v2.pdf (agenda), Compact_QBR_runofshow.xlsx (detailed minute-by-minute).

Laura — can you own the demo deck updates (use-case prioritization) if Anna confirms a slot? Stephanie, please standby for a shortened tech pre-brief and to confirm SE availability.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
+1 (646) 555-0114
message_3_body:
Markus / Anna —

Quick procurement note: Nov 27/28/29 works from our side for a product demo, but we require the final draft of any contract exhibit or SOW at least 72 hours before signing. If you plan to surface pricing or a term sheet during the session, please send the draft immediately after confirming the slot.

Also: procurement will need a brief (1 page) summary of data handling (audit logs, retention, encryption at rest) to attach to our legal review. If you can include that as an appendix in the deck, it speeds review.

Thanks — Carl
Carl Ng
Senior Procurement Manager | Catalina Health
message_4_subject: Internal: Catalina compact QBR — deliverables & timings
message_4_body:
Team — quick ops note after Carl's reply:

Action list: 
- Laura: finalize the 1-page data handling appendix and insert on slide 18 of the deck. Use our SOC2 summary and the 'Retention and Audit Log' table from the repo. Deadline: EOD Nov 21.
- Stephanie: confirm SE (Rajesh) for Wed 11/29 08:30 PST or Tue 11/28 14:00 PST — which is better for his calendar? Also prepare a 10-minute pre-record for the exec highlight. Deadline: EOD Nov 21.
- Markus: I'll confirm the slot once Anna replies. Pull in pricing exhibit if Anna wants pricing surfaced.

Keep replies short — we need to move fast on the procurement window.

—Markus
message_5_subject: Confirmed — Compact QBR (90 min) Wed Nov 29 08:30–10:00 PST
message_5_body:
Anna / Carl —

Thanks for the quick responses. Wed Nov 29 08:30–10:00 PST is booked on our side and confirmed for Catalina Health. Agenda and the 1-page data handling appendix are attached (Laura finalized).

Two logistics:
- We will circulate a short pre-read and the 10-minute exec highlight recording 24 hours prior.
- Carl — the pricing exhibit and draft SOW are attached; per your note, please confirm the 72-hour review window and any required format changes. If procurement needs a separate DocuSign envelope, reply and we'll trigger the contract team.

Calendar invite will follow; joining info: Zoom link in invite + webinar dial-in. If you need a different platform, let me know.

See you Wednesday —
Markus Klein
